reviews.text: Highly recommended. The service is excellent, and the team are caring, friendly and professional. They treat every fog as if it were their own.
Absolutely stunning premises, and the care shown to my golden oldie while getting hydrotherapie was incredible. I highly recommend this place. It also has a groomers and kennels on site.
The staff are top class, our dog looks really well after every grooming! Highly recommended
Absolutely top notch in every aspect. They take great care of your dogs and I would have no hesitation in recommending them.

I would highly recommend top dogs for grooming and boarding kennels! Our dog  Romy loves staying here!  Lee Ann who looks after her grooming is excellent and Margot is great to book the kennels with ⭐️🐶
Lovely place for our dog to stay.He was very well looked after.
Brought my 5 month old puppy for her first groom.  They did a great job.  She looks fab
Contacted privately with feedback

Cannot thank margot and her team enough.

We brought marley over to get him groomed and were absoultly thrilled with the outcome.

Would highly recoomend top dog🎉

Thanks guys see yous again.

If you value your dog don't ever leave your dog here. I agree with other reviews. Staff are rude and my dog came back with bite marks on her, and didn't bark for 3 days when i got her back. I fully suspect they put a bark collar on her. She was traumatised. They constantly tell pet owners their dogs bark too much, yet they are a dog boarding kennel. My dog is a small placid dog and rarely barks unless she is stressed. She told a friend of mine to smack her dog to put manners on it.

Excellent care and friendly service and environment. Knowledgeable staff it is home from home for Cooper and Quinn they are treated as family when they are there i never have to worry. Thanks for all your help and advice Margot. 🤗 …
Highly recommend this grooming service. The standards of care and quality is unbelievable. Your dog is cared for, given the appropriate breaks needed and comes home looking unreal.
Great location, efficient & welcoming staff. My pup always very happy.

Delighted with my dogs happy faces after their three weeks stay. I left my three dogs with margot and team and so happy with their care. More importantly my dogs were obviously happy, cared for and clean!  If I needed an update when I was away I just sent a text and my mind was put at ease always responded to,
I have booked for Christmas and next year's holidays already! Thank you Top Dogs team  THE BEST x

Margot and her team looked after my two whippets while I was away on holiday and I could not be more pleased with the service. One of my dogs had sustained a broken leg and was still recovering from complications prior to her stay and they kept my mind at ease with reassurance they provided to me about the care they give to make her stay comfortable. They walked her out on lead as she couldn’t be left to run around in a run by herself (she has very little sense of self preservation when the zoomies hit) and kept her with them at lunch times as she needed a bit of extra care and time outside of her kennel. My dogs were incredibly well looked after and I could not recommend them enough. You can tell that they care about your dogs and will be meticulous with their care. Immaculate facilities and the staff genuinely care greatly about animals.

I don't seem to be able to reply to owner's comment so I'm editing my earlier review below here. As I said I had to ask for an update. This should be sent without asking, especially as my dogs had never been there before. My main issue was the rude attitude on arrival and collection. The dogs were immediately taken from me without speaking to me or giving me a chance to say goodbye to them. Then I was very abruptly told they needed the kennel back before lunchtime on my return date. I had to organise for my sister to collect the dogs, and she also received the same rude treatment. It's not a lot to expect a little polite conversation especially as this was our first time leaving our dogs there. It made me anxious for the week. There is no confusion, I have been very clear what the issue was. How about saying sorry that you were so rude? I see I'm not the only one who felt this way either.

The facility is very nice, clean and professional looking and my dogs were perfectly fine when I came back.
But.. I was very disappointed with the attitude of staff and extremely unfriendly greeting and collection. No updates on the dogs either during the week, I had to ask, so that made me anxious about my dogs on holiday. They need to remember people are paying for this service and they are not doing you a favour, which seems to be the attitude. Won't be going back.
First visit highly impressed. My new dogs first grooming and I was astounded at the outcome. He was so knotted they had to cut him to the bone but it was beautiful. Thank you I loved what you did
Brilliant and extremely professional

Would not recommend these kennels. Was horrified with the treatment we and our dog received. Our dog was abruptly taken off us, no questions asked, no option to view facilities or where he would be sleeping, no information on daily routine etc. I immediately felt uncomfortable about the set up. No updates were given while he was there. On pick up the lady was extremely rude and gave out about him but wouldn’t give me the time of day to go into more detail. I got the impression that she had no patience for him because he is a large dog. He has been in kennels before and they have absolutely loved him. He was extremely stressed after his time there and we also got back a day’s worth of his food we had portioned out. Never again.

We have been bringing our doggos to margot and her fabulous crew for over 12 years now, i wouldn’t bring them anywhere else, before we book a holiday we check if she has availability to take our dogs, otherwise we dont go on holidays. Their groomers are also brilliant

Henry advised me on a product he sells, I found this product excellent in both quality and price, as a dog owner for over 40 years ,I have no hesitation in recommending Top Dog in any of their services as it is imperative to get the correct advice at various stages of your dogs life, this is available at Top Dog.
Anthony :Tipperary,
Great place, ran by the best people. My two dogs love it there and don't look back when I drop them off:) highly recommended
All the girls here in the physio are so nice and so caring towards their four legged patients. Would highly recommend them
Great for dog's physio therapy
It was my first time bringing my dog to physio and the experience was great.
I regularly leave my dog, Kody, here for grooming and for day care (drop off after 7:30 and pick up before 17:00), never any issues, great place and friendly staff.
Jakes lives it
Great team, so helpful.
We have used Top Dog for grooming and kennel care and will continue to do so.
Wonderful! Excellent grooming and hydrotherapy- the team takes such wonderful care of my dog. The level of care, professionalism and attention is exceptional. Always! Thank you!

The only place I would ever board our greyhound, they adore him and he loves going in, Margot goes above and beyond in the care she provides.  Plus the staff never change, a testimony to how well she must look after them too!

Cannot recommend these enough, have had our dogs here multiple times and always been great. Our larger dog has a bad leg post surgery and they have always been accommodating. They tend to eat their bed the first night but the guys here always make sure they have a spare duvet to give them.
Doggy heaven see to believe 💯 …

Our dogs have been attending Top Dog Kennels since 2016 and have always received 5 Star treatment. One of our dogs, Belle, suffered a traumatic experience in her previous home and had a number of trust issues when she arrived to us. However, whilst being kenneled at Top Dogs over the years, her confidence has grown around other dogs and people. I noticed her regress during Covid due to not being able to go to Top Dog. Both my dogs love going there and walk off with the staff wagging tails and never looking back at us. It's their home away from home!! Thank you Margot and all your lovely staff for a top class service.
Very friendly an reassuring
Excellent service - my dog loves it here!

Would not recommend if you like to feel reassured that your dog is truly being taken care of. There is no option to view the actual facilities and your dog is taken from you / brought back to you in the entrance car park. No updates are provided while your dog is there, and when we collected our dog the staff member complained that she barked too often which we know only ever happens when she is left alone constantly or for long periods of time. Wouldn’t use again.
Very good groomers
Excellent establishment, Jake loves his days there, and the grooming service is also excellent.
Beautiful place for your dog! Clean and really organised! My dog is happy every time I drop her there
